Name: Noise Type
Description: Selects the algorithm used to generate noise. Each type produces a distinct pattern and character, suitable for different terrain or texture effects.

Flubs.Name: Random
Flubs.Description: Generates pure random noise, resulting in a highly chaotic and unstructured pattern.

Flubs.Name: Perlin
Flubs.Description: Produces smooth, gradient-based noise with natural transitions, ideal for organic terrain features.

Flubs.Name: Gaussian
Flubs.Description: Applies a Gaussian distribution to the noise, creating patterns with a bell-curve intensity and softer transitions.

Flubs.Name: Fixed
Flubs.Description: Generates a noise pattern based on large, finite shapes.

Flubs.Name: Micro
Flubs.Description: Creates very fine, high-frequency noise suitable for adding subtle surface detail or micro-variation.

Name: Height
Description: Controls the maximum amplitude or elevation of the noise, affecting how pronounced the noise appears in the output.

Name: Density
Description: Adjusts the frequency or scale of the noise pattern. Higher density results in more frequent variations across the terrain.

Name: Relative Density
Description: When enabled, density is scaled relative to the current resolution or context, maintaining consistent detail at different scales.

Name: Blend Mode
Description: Determines how the generated noise is combined with the input or base layer, affecting the final appearance.

Flubs.Name: Add
Flubs.Description: Adds the noise values to the input, increasing elevation or intensity where noise is present.

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description: Multiplies the input by the noise values, modulating the base layer and enhancing contrast.

Flubs.Name: Subtract
Flubs.Description: Subtracts the noise values from the input, reducing elevation or intensity in noisy areas.

Name: Seed
Description: Sets the randomization seed for the noise generation. Changing the seed produces a different noise pattern while keeping other settings the same.
